[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Anna was born about 1847 in Plains, Lanarkshire, Scotland. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-424|John Glasgow]] and [[Forsyth-878|Christina Forsyth]].

In 1851 Anna was living at 37 Aitchison Street New Monkland with her parents, siblings and granny<ref> (Scotland Census 1851; Parish: New Monkland; ED:8; Page:16; Line:14; Roll: cssct1851_170)</ref>

In 1861 Anna was a cotton weaver at 45 Aitchison Street New Monklands with her father and siblings.<ref> (Scotland Census 1861; Parish: new Monkland; ED:7; Page:11; Line:8; Roll:cssct1861_117)</ref>
